subject.title: ScreenCaptureKit transient-denial retry swallows cancellation (second attempt after cancel)

question: Does the live production-runner evidence in https://github.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pull/290 satisfy the previously stated ScreenCaptureKit proof gate, or must it additionally show a signed true-TCC denial and the permission-probe path before merge?
rationale: The source-level change is narrow, but the prior maintainer gate specifically distinguished live signed/TCC evidence from modeled or injected proof; only an owner can relax or interpret that acceptance threshold.

options.title: Accept the current live runner proof
options.body: Treat the real `SCStreamErrorDomain` runner transcript plus focused tests as sufficient and review the implementation normally.

options.title: Require the remaining proof surfaces
options.body: Ask for signed true-TCC-denial evidence and a live permission-probe exercise before accepting the combined repair.

options.title: Waive the live gate explicitly
options.body: Accept deterministic regression coverage as sufficient for this cancellation family and record that the extra hardware/TCC proof is not required.

recommendation.title: Accept the current live runner proof
recommendation.body: Treat the real `SCStreamErrorDomain` runner transcript plus focused tests as sufficient and review the implementation normally.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded prior closeout attributes the proof re-entry criteria to steipete.
